I've saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and told Anselm in the DM. The draft hasn't been sent; someone still needs to send it from drafts.

- **Draft:** The subject is "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,101 per-seat rate as Marcus provided it, says Anselm approved sharing it, and asks Hollis to keep it internal.
- **Why no further approval was needed:** Hollis isn't one of the people finance figures can go to by default, so they need sign-off from Anselm or June. Anselm is the CFO and gave that sign-off in this message. The mail stays inside pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway's approval for outside addresses doesn't apply.
- **The figure wasn't checked:** I couldn't find Marcus's original $2,101 figure in the brain, which had semantic search off. The draft uses the number exactly as Anselm gave it, and I told Anselm that in my reply.
